facts.fact: Aiden 在利兹火车站下车时低着头、戴着深蓝针织帽，只想避免被认出。
facts.anchor: He kept his head down, covered by a navy blue beanie hat, just in case.

facts.fact: 他在心里过了一遍可能的解释，找不到一个能让前妻相信的说法。
facts.anchor: Running through a mental list of possible explanations, he came upon none that would strike his ex-wife as plausible.

facts.fact: 多年来没有人提起 Emily，一句都没有。
facts.anchor: All those years of hearing nothing about Emily, not a single mention by anyone

facts.fact: 他反复强调 Emily 当时十九岁、是完全同意的成年人，而且是她先开始的。
facts.anchor: Emily had been nineteen years old, a fully consenting adult. And most importantly, she had started it.

facts.fact: 她摊在床上、一动不动、毫无生气的画面一有浮现的迹象，他就把它压下去。
facts.anchor: Whenever the memory of her sprawled on her bed, immobile and lifeless, threatened to surface in his mind

facts.fact: 他在加的夫只住着 Roath 一栋小排屋底层的单身公寓，生活孤独。
facts.anchor: A lonely bachelor flat on the ground floor of a small, terraced house in Roath.

facts.fact: 一个空落的周末，他找到了几个女学生的社交媒体账号。
facts.anchor: During one empty weekend, he had found a few of his female students’ social media accounts.

facts.fact: 他在 Otley Road 下出租车时心跳加快。
facts.anchor: Climbing out of the taxi on to Otley Road, he felt his heartbeat quicken.
